docs/BUSINESS_CASE.md 'What would have to change to NOT reach $100K' -> 'Annual mix stays at 0%' -- the shippable-TODAY figure, on the CONSERVATIVE store channel. RE-PRICED 2026-07-28 from $99,926: that reading was ~$74 below the floor purely because it applied a 30% commission this business pays on neither channel at this scale. Now clears the floor on the store channel at $121,339 and on web/Stripe at $136,762 (business_case_web_channel_arr). Tight tolerance: the figure under active auditor scrutiny.

docs/BUSINESS_CASE.md 'What would have to change to NOT reach $100K' -> 'Monthly Pro churn rises from 7% to 12%' -- RE-PRICED 2026-07-28 from $93,556 by the take-rate correction. This downside now clears the floor; before the correction it did not.
docs/BUSINESS_CASE.md 'What would have to change to NOT reach $100K' -> 'Annual renewal churn rises to 40%' -- RE-PRICED 2026-07-28 from $103,214 by the take-rate correction.

docs/BUSINESS_CASE.md 'Channel economics' -- the WEB/Stripe reading of the shippable-TODAY case (Scenario B inputs, annual gated off), priced at Stripe's published 2.9% + $0.30 (+0.7% Billing on recurring) instead of a store commission.
